quotedSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate. To stop a renewal you must deliver written notice of cancellation to the Member Services desk no later than three (3) days before the renewal date.
paragraph: Your initial membership term is twelve (12) months, beginning on the Commencement Date shown on your enrolment form. At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate. To stop a renewal you must deliver written notice of cancellation to the Member Services desk no later than three (3) days before the renewal date. Notice delivered after that day takes effect at the end of the term that follows, and the dues for the intervening term remain payable in full. A membership that has been suspended, frozen or placed on medical hold continues to renew on its original schedule.

paragraph: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
